authorization: Owner requested guided Safari voice testing in the isolated owner copy over Wi-Fi/cellular, retaining Heart, Dad and no API billing. The owner identified an iPhone 14 Pro Max; iOS version is unknown.

deployment.production: existing Sol-high/Heart, no restart or deployment

method.automatic: Detected speech end, endpointing, complete reply request, first-WAV headers/download/decode, owner audio-preparation Server-Timing and Web Audio scheduling. Numeric ASR/model/whole-turn telemetry is correlated by submitted turn ID.
method.manual: The I hear her answer tap includes human reaction time and is stored separately. It is not a calibrated acoustic onset. Audible-response ground truth remains null.
method.network: User chooses Wi-Fi/cellular and browser/audio condition. The page cannot prove network type. Same scenario order and device/output; repeat with reversed network order before causal conclusions.
method.correctness: Human rates transcription, answer, responsiveness and a bounded problem code. The schedule scenario expects the deliberately disconnected owner Outlook limit; it does not qualify a working connector.
method.pause_lock: Existing 900 ms endpointing and disabled acoustic interruption preserved. Deliberate pause and lock/resume can fail; failures/missing observations are retained rather than converted to successes.

privacy.storage: ignored owner-only private directory; no care ledger writes by the study
privacy.new_retained_content: fixed scenario IDs, numeric stages, fixed-choice ratings and lifecycle events only
privacy.displayed_text: Current transcription/reply displayed for checking, not stored in study results. Normal authorized Nancy/Pro processing remains unchanged; no new provider-retention guarantee.
privacy.authority: Fresh server-derived owner actor, client role, synthetic participant, login and grant revision on each route; sample delivery also verifies retained reply authority. No client-supplied actor/account/role.
privacy.replay: Identical pass/sample/event submissions are idempotent; changed reused payloads rejected; explicit rating edits supported.

verification.desktop_browser: Actual deployed page visibly loads the signed-in Before you start controls. No desktop microphone/conversation was started, and this is not Safari/device acceptance.
verification.initial_checks: An early test-only mock typing error was corrected. The first sandbox Vitest attempt could not create its temporary cache and executed zero tests; that incomplete report is retained privately. Final focused and full runs pass on the qualified revision.
verification.refinement: Manual hearing-tap control remains in the sticky header, each pass clears old diagnostic queues, and failed timing saves can finish as explicit missing-observation events. Final focused/typecheck/build/full suite and deployed checks repeated on this revision; prior passing source/evidence retained privately.

accounting.correction: Initial zero-provider-call assumption was wrong: existing authenticated-session/page access starts the already-enabled foreground meal preload. Two actual Pro model calls are counted from numeric telemetry. No new benchmark was run. This is retrospective accounting; no new predeclared request-cap guard was in place for that existing preparation.
accounting.normal_preparation: Foreground meal preparation remains enabled on page/session access, before Talk. It is separate from microphone capture and starting a conversation. Phone turns and their normal preparation use the same immutable owner Pro route; actual usage/unknowns remain in telemetry.

rollback: Private previous owner client and changed existing source backups retained; rollback is scoped to the owner page/process. Dad is not a rollback target.
private_evidence_ref: .local/safari-voice-2026-10-23/ and .local/owner-test/safari-study/ (ignored; exact bindings/process identities and any future tester results stay private)
limitations: No actual phone result exists yet.
Manual taps include reaction time; scheduled playback is not audibility.
Whole-turn/model/audio-preparation values overlap; do not add them as independent stages.
A single paired Wi-Fi/cellular pass cannot establish reliable percentiles or a causal network effect.
This is an owner test instrument, not a production design or completed S01 acceptance.
